description: shadcn-svelte's shimmer utility as Chromium 153 paints it on virtual time: a background gradient (relative colours from currentColor, colour mixing, a registered angle) clipped to the text (background-clip: text) through a transparent -webkit-text-fill-color, its background-position animated (tw-shimmer, linear, infinite; once; reversed in right-to-left text), with angle, colour, duration and spread variants, in a flex item (Marker.Content) and a truncated block with an ellipsis (the attachment title), and shimmer-none toggled on and off
